items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes, I know of him.

ctx.x: I see. The reason -- one of the reasons I'm interested in this particularly is that -- you know Brooks Kerr (ABOMINIC), don't you? The young pianist in New York who's the Ellington specialist?
Oh, yes, I know of him.
Yeah. Well, Brooks is 25 years old and Brooks told me that he's always been fascinated by your playing.
